faqs.question: Tell me about yourself
faqs.answer: I'm Pratheesh Clement — a Freelance Digital Marketer, Website Developer, and SEO Specialist based in Chennai, India. I design responsive, high-performance web applications and build conversion-focused ad funnels to help businesses scale. I hold a Google Digital Marketing certification and specialize in Technical SEO, Google & Meta Ads, and AI workflow automation.

faqs.question: What services do you provide?
faqs.answer: I offer Website Development, Technical SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Digital Marketing Strategy, Landing Page Development, Website Optimization, AI & Automation workflows, and Personal Branding. I also provide a FREE Website Health Audit to get started.

faqs.question: Why should I hire you?
faqs.answer: I combine three powerful disciplines in one: technical web development, data-driven digital marketing, and AI automation. I don't just build websites — I build digital ecosystems that rank on search engines, convert visitors into leads, and scale with your business. My work is clean, performance-optimized, and measurable.

faqs.question: Show your best project
faqs.answer: My flagship project is this very Digital Ecosystem Portfolio — built with pure HTML5, CSS3, and Vanilla JS, targeting Lighthouse scores of 100 across Performance, Accessibility, and SEO. I also successfully ran a B2B Meta Ads campaign that significantly reduced cost-per-lead while generating pre-qualified business inquiries.

faqs.question: What is your tech stack?
faqs.answer: For web development: HTML5, CSS3 with custom properties, Vanilla JavaScript. For SEO: JSON-LD Schema, Google Search Console, robots.txt, XML Sitemaps. For ads: Google Ads Manager, Meta Business Suite. For automation: Zapier, API integrations. For AI: Gemini, ChatGPT workflows.

faqs.answer: Yes! I hold the Google Fundamentals of Digital Marketing certification (Completion ID: 453421024), accredited by the Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB) Europe and The Open University, issued March 14, 2026.
